cold_chain_share_ppm.note: share of items that need the refrigerated range; stylised, not fitted (docs/use-cases.md section 3)

controlled_share_ppm.note: share of items with a per-order cap; stylised

critical_share_ppm.note: share of items whose absence costs more; stylised

refill_interval_days.note: [days, weight]; monthly or a 90-day supply; stylised

shelf_capacity_units.note: [units, weight]; a pharmacy's ambient shelf space; stylised

cold_capacity_units.note: [units, weight]; a pharmacy's refrigerated space; stylised

age_band_weights.note: weights of 18-39, 40-54, 55-64, 65-74, 75+ among patients on chronic medicines; stylised

copay_band_weights.note: weights of low, mid, high co-payment; stylised

therapeutic_group_weights.note: weights of chronic, respiratory, allergy items; stylised

season_amplitude_ppm.note: seasonal swing of weekly demand per group (chronic, respiratory, allergy): peak is 1+amp, trough 1-amp times the base; stylised

season_peak_week.note: week of the year (0 to 51) of each group's peak: respiratory in midwinter, allergy in spring; stylised

item_base_rate_milli.note: [units per week x 1000, weight] of an item at a pharmacy of scale 1; stylised

pharmacy_scale_ppm.note: [scale x 1e6, weight] of a pharmacy's demand against the base; stylised

order_cover_ppm.note: the pharmacy orders up to 1.5 times its recent weekly sales; a plain policy on purpose, so that stockouts and write-offs occur; stylised

trailing_weeks.note: weeks of the pharmacy's own sales (censored by stockouts) that its policy averages; stylised
